lines.text: The men who arrested Jesus led Him to the house of Caiaphas, and Peter followed at a distance.
After many false witnesses failed, two said Jesus claimed He could destroy the walls of Jerusalem in three days.
Jesus stayed silent, then answered the oath, and the high priest tore his clothes and cried blasphemy.
A servant girl said Peter was with Jesus the Galilean, and he denied it, then swore an oath.
Bystanders said Peter's sword gave him away, he cursed and swore, a rooster crowed, and he wept bitterly.
